statements.t: Our Real Estate Management Services business provides a broad suite of integrated services to occupiers of real estate, including facility and property management, project management, portfolio and other services, and software and technology solutions.

Compared with the prior-year periods, Real Estate Management Services revenue growth for the third quarter and first nine months of 2026 was attributable to continued momentum within Workplace Management and, for the quarter, accelerated growth in Project Management.

Project Management's double-digit growth for the quarter follows a strong third-quarter 2025 (up 38% on a two-year stacked basis), with higher pass-through costs augmenting a mid single-digit management fee increase.

Project Management growth in the first nine months of 2026 benefited from the stronger third-quarter performance and also followed a meaningful increase in the prior-year period (up 21%), also with higher pass-through costs augmenting a mid single-digit management fee increase.

Based on our historical experience and future business plans, we do not expect to repatriate our foreign-sourced earnings to the United States.
